samples.title: Thói quen đi bộ
samples.prompt: A local centre is recruiting a paid part-time Community Activities Assistant to help deliver a neighbourhood walking event. Write to Ms Brown to apply. Explain your relevant experience and skills, your motivation and availability, and request an interview.

samples.summaryVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư và ứng tuyển
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to apply for the position of part-time Community Activities Assistant. I am interested in this opportunity because it would allow me to contribute to a neighbourhood walking event while developing my skills in a practical working environment.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu tên công việc được tuyển, không chỉ xin tham gia sự kiện.

parts.text: Dear
Ms Brown
parts.labelVi: danh xưng và họ người nhận

parts.text:
,

I am writing to apply for the position of
part-time Community Activities Assistant
. I am interested in this opportunity because it would allow me to contribute to
a neighbourhood walking event
while developing my skills in a practical working environment.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

I am writing to apply for the position of [vị trí ứng tuyển]. I am interested in this opportunity because it would allow me to contribute to [sự kiện / hoạt động] while developing my skills in a practical working environment.

paragraphs.label: Kinh nghiệm và kỹ năng
paragraphs.text: I have experience in welcoming participants and preparing materials for activities at my college. This has helped me learn to explain simple instructions, organise tasks and respond politely to questions. I believe these skills would be useful when helping participants explore a short local route and note useful improvements. I am willing to learn and would take care to follow the instructions given by my supervisor.
paragraphs.noteVi: Kinh nghiệm, kỹ năng phải là điều đúng với ứng viên.

paragraphs.text: I am particularly interested in walking as a daily habit because people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines. I am available on weekday afternoons and at weekends. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application at an interview and provide any further information you may need.
